recognize_zh: CD3 染色中，密集的中型腫瘤細胞呈顆粒狀、核周點狀的細胞質陽性（cytoplasmic CD3ε），而散在的正常小 T 細胞為較深且完整的膜性染色，呈「雙色調」差異，是 NK 細胞表型的線索。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei
Granular, dot-like and perinuclear cytoplasmic CD3 staining in most neoplastic cells
Lack of crisp circumferential membranous staining in the neoplastic cells
Scattered cells with darker, more solid staining (reactive T cells) providing a two-tone contrast
Endothelial-lined vessel at upper left with negative spindle nuclei
describe_en: CD3 immunostain shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with granular and perinuclear cytoplasmic staining, without the crisp membranous pattern expected of mature T cells. Scattered admixed cells with darker, more uniform staining represent reactive T cells and create a two-tone pattern. This cytoplasmic CD3ε pattern in the absence of surface CD3 supports an NK-cell phenotype. With CD56, cytotoxic granule protein, and EBER positivity, findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS cells usually show membranous surface CD3 and are EBER negative in most cases.
Shares cytoplasmic CD3ε/CD56/EBER positivity but presents as a systemic leukemic process with marrow and blood involvement rather than a localized nasal mass.
BPDCN is CD3 negative and expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 without EBV or cytotoxic granules.
